_comment: AnkiBrain Voice runtime manifest. THIS FILE IS THE PIN OF TRUTH: every
version + hash the bootstrap downloads appears here (uv itself, CPython
build, Kokoro-82M HF revision, pyopenjtalk wheelhouse). Bump together
with voice/uv.lock when the engine dependencies change; a state.json
whose manifest hash differs triggers the self-heal re-sync.

unsupported_platforms.darwin-x86_64: Intel Macs are not supported: PyTorch no longer publishes macOS x86_64 wheels. An Apple Silicon Mac (M1 or newer) is required for AnkiBrain Voice.

python._comment: Installed via `uv python install` (python-build-standalone, checksum-verified by uv). UV_PYTHON_INSTALL_DIR keeps it under user_files/voice/.

model._comment: Warmup downloads model .pth + config + the catalog voices' .pt files. HF_HOME points at user_files/voice/hf_cache.

detector._comment: Automatic TTS source-language detection (Settings > Voice > Auto-detect). Pin lives here + voice/uv.lock and uv.lock is authoritative; confidence thresholds live in KokoroTTS/__init__.py and are calibrated via KokoroTTS/lang_check.py. Any change here bumps the manifest hash and triggers the self-heal re-sync.

spacy_model.name: en_core_web_sm
spacy_model._comment: misaki's English G2P loads this pipeline (spacy.util.is_package / spacy.cli.download). Relying on the runtime download breaks in a uv venv without pip on PATH, so the bootstrap installs the wheel explicitly and verifies the import.

_comment: Prebuilt cp311 wheels for packages that publish sdist only (pyopenjtalk).
Maintainer procedure: build once per pyopenjtalk bump per platform via
cibuildwheel (needs cmake + C/C++ toolchain per OS), upload to a GitHub
release tagged in `release`, publish exact version + sha256 per asset.
While an entry is null the bootstrap falls back to `uv sync`, which builds
from source if cmake/CC are present, and otherwise errors with guidance.

size_estimates_mb._comment: Rounded upper estimates for the setup modal copy only (download, disk). uv archive + managed CPython + core wheels + model. ja adds ~300MB download.
